name: Obeying The Will Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that obeying the will of God involves a heartfelt delight in His law and a commitment to live justly, love mercy, and walk humbly before Him, as shown in Psalms 40:8 and Micah 6:8. Jesus emphasizes that entering the kingdom of heaven requires doing the will of the Father, not merely professing faith (Matthew 7:21), and identifies those who obey God's will as His true family (Matthew 12:50). Even in moments of personal struggle, Christ models submission to God's will above His own desires (Luke 22:42), while teaching believers to pray for God's will to be done on earth as in heaven (Matthew 6:10).
